message: Optimize rate limiting performance: cache JWT user lookups in Redis, add token blacklist middleware for instant 429 rejection, remove OTel tracing overhead from throttle, and reorganize throttling code into a dedicated package.
bullet_points: Cache authenticated user+profile in Redis (configurable via BASEROW_JWT_USER_CACHE_TTL) to eliminate per-request DB query
Add ThrottleBlacklistMiddleware that rejects previously throttled tokens before auth/DRF runs (zero DB queries)
Support optional IP-based blacklisting for anonymous requests (BASEROW_THROTTLE_IP_BLACKLIST_ENABLED)
Remove OpenTelemetry tracing from ConcurrentUserRequestsThrottle and CoreHandler.clear_context
Add configurable BASEROW_CONN_MAX_AGE for database connection reuse
Suppress django.request WARNING logs under heavy throttling (BASEROW_DJANGO_REQUEST_LOG_LEVEL)
